curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can Basil and Dawson evade Professor Ratigan’s ultimate trap and foil his planned crime?
curatedMovie.description: Professor Ratigan’s kidnapping puts Basil of Baker Street and Dawson on the trail of a crime threatening London’s master toymaker.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Animated family mystery with a London setting, a diabolical villain, and a brisk crime-solving adventure.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: A tight 74-minute animated mystery pairing classic detective flair with energetic peril, ideal for quick family viewing and classic crime-solving thrills.

facts.director: Burny Mattinson & John Musker & David Michener & Ron Clements
facts.title: The Great Mouse Detective
